name: Folate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A B-vitamin cofactor in one-carbon metabolism. Supplemental folate can mask the haematological signs of vitamin B12 deficiency while the neurological damage progresses, which is why the two are read together.

systems.note: Repletion of a cofactor required for erythropoiesis; the intended effect.
Masks the macrocytosis of B12 deficiency while neurological damage continues.

monitors.why: Folate masks the haematological signal of B12 deficiency; the two must be read together.
The functional readout of one-carbon sufficiency.
